description: Source code for the StreamingProcessor class managing camera streaming requests, streams, and configurations in Android's camera HAL.

classes.name: StreamingProcessor
classes.description: Manages camera streaming requests, streams, and configurations for preview and recording in Android camera HAL.

methods.name: setPreviewWindow
methods.description: Sets the surface for camera preview output.

methods.name: setRecordingWindow
methods.description: Sets the surface for camera recording output.

methods.name: haveValidPreviewWindow
methods.description: Checks if a valid preview window is set.

methods.name: haveValidRecordingWindow
methods.description: Checks if a valid recording window is set.

methods.name: updatePreviewRequest
methods.description: Updates the camera preview request with new parameters.

methods.name: updatePreviewStream
methods.description: Creates or updates the preview stream with specified parameters.

methods.name: getPreviewStreamId
methods.description: Returns the current preview stream ID.

methods.name: updateRecordingRequest
methods.description: Updates the recording request with new parameters.

methods.name: recordingStreamNeedsUpdate
methods.description: Checks if the recording stream needs to be updated based on parameters.

methods.name: updateRecordingStream
methods.description: Creates or updates the recording stream with specified parameters.

methods.name: getRecordingStreamId
methods.description: Returns the current recording stream ID.

methods.name: startStream
methods.description: Starts streaming for preview or recording with specified output streams.

methods.name: togglePauseStream
methods.description: Pauses or resumes the current streaming.

methods.name: getActiveRequestId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the active request.

methods.name: incrementStreamingIds
methods.description: Increments request IDs for preview and recording streams.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state and requests for debugging.
